newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Salinas y Rocha gains sharply.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Salinas y Rocha gains sharply.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican retailer Grupo Salinas y Rocha (GSYR) where sharply up in early afternoon trading on the Mexican bourse on Tuesday.
GSYR A shares had gained 10 centavos to 75 centavos on what analysts and dealers said were substantially improved earnings and recent news of a restructuring program.
"GSYR still posted an operating loss, but the important thing is that it fell dramatically," said Deyanira Becerril, a retail sector analyst at the Inverlat brokerage.
The retailer posted an operating loss of 6.86 million pesos for the first half of 1997 after the close of stock trading on Monday, compared with a year-ago loss of 122.91 million pesos.

On Thursday, July 24, GSYR announced it would reduce its shareholders equity from 348 million pesos to 20 million in order to absorb accumulated losses. The firm said creditor banks would also absorb losses by securitizing 80 million pesos of debt.
